<function name="SetSolidMask" parent="NextBot" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the solid mask for given NextBot.

The default solid mask of a NextBot is <page text="MASK_NPCSOLID">Enums/MASK</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="mask" type="number">The new mask, see <page>Enums/CONTENTS</page> and <page>Enums/MASK</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>
